name: General Mills - Cedar Rapids IA (Wenig Rd)

fieldNotes.ROSTER_ERROR: The roster address for idx 1 (1000 Wenig Rd NE, Cedar Rapids) is incorrect. Satellite imagery of that point shows the Cedar Rapids Water Pollution Control Facility (wastewater treatment - circular clarifier/aeration tanks), NOT a General Mills plant. Web research (Cedar Rapids Metro Economic Alliance directory) confirms there is only ONE General Mills facility in Cedar Rapids: the cereal plant at 4800 Edgewood Rd SW. idx 1 and idx 2 are therefore the SAME physical facility. This file audits that actual GM plant; it is a duplicate of idx 2.
fieldNotes.location: Audited the real General Mills Cedar Rapids cereal plant at 4800 Edgewood Rd SW (41.9322,-91.7202). The Wenig Rd NE coordinate in the roster was discarded as erroneous.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by black ornamental metal perimeter fence (visible in 2019/2024 Street View along the access road off Edgewood Rd SW). Single private access road; GM directional signage 'Frontage Road'/'South Entrance'. Controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identifiable from Street View - public road panos do not extend onto the private entry drive. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth; low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive multi-track rail yard along the south edge with many covered hopper cars; rail spurs enter rail-served loading canopies. Definitively rail-served.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: SW distribution warehouse dock bank (~20+ trailers) plus central process and rail-served docks. Estimated 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large organized trailer drop yard at the NW corner (~120-150 trailers) plus additional staged trailers. Well over 50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Central process complex, SW distribution warehouse, two NW warehouses, and rail-served structures - multiple distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and large interior aprons leave room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter ~224 acres including rail yard and retention/undeveloped land; paved core ~90-110 acres.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting amid farmland and a quarry; classified Rural.
